title: Effective Resistances and Commute Times in Sparse Random Geometric Graphs
summary: The commute time between two nodes in a network - the expected number of steps for a random walk to travel from one node to the other and then return - is a metric of broad importance arising in community detection, network routing, dimensionality reduction, and diffusion modeling.
